distribution.summary: Heilongjiang; Taiwan; Gansu; Jilin; Liaoning; Sichuan; Shaanxi
distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) records Heilongjiang; Shaanxi; Sichuan; Huang & Lu (2015) retains only Heilongjiang and explicitly omits Shaanxi; Sichuan. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds Taiwan and gives broad China (NE, NO, SW, WP); that broad wording is not expanded into provinces and does not resolve the baseline province conflict. Current synthesis therefore treats Heilongjiang and Taiwan as current confirmed units, with Shaanxi; Sichuan retained as historical/questionable. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Gansu, Jilin, Liaoning, Sichuan, Shaanxi as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) provide Picea koraiensis, Picea microsperma, Pinus koraiensis, Pinus armandii and Pinus tabulaeformis. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Pinus spp.; this genus-level evidence is retained in addition to the species-level records.
